experiment: OBSERVER-R11 — DOES SELECTIVE SURVIVAL CAUSALLY SUPPORT DOWNSTREAM READOUT?

primary_intervention.type: pairwise semantic-preserving residual rotation of an already-present controlled relation distinction
primary_intervention.controlled_pair: base memory and relation-j +1 mod16 counterfactual, same permutation
primary_intervention.construction: At h1, form pair midpoint m and normalized distinction d. Let e be the validation-trained linear relation decoder value-b minus value-a gradient. Decompose d=a e+b r. Replace residual r by normalized interpolation toward projected J^T J min-gain direction for high-reader suppression or max-gain direction for low-reader rescue. Preserve pair norm and coefficients a and |b| exactly. Apply symmetrically around midpoint.
primary_intervention.primary_baseline: semantic-matched random residual rotation using same a,b,pair norm and interpolation strength
primary_intervention.high_low_groups: validation-only top4/bottom4 final-reader relation accuracy, identical rule to R10

semantic_envelope.selection: largest strength satisfying every threshold in every seed on validation aggregate; thresholds locked before test

primary_endpoints.functional_statistic: matching relation final-reader margin change minus mean off-relation margin change, targeted minus semantic-matched random
primary_endpoints.pair_statistic: change in matching reader-logit pair separation, targeted minus semantic-matched random

survival.terminal_alignment: cosine between terminal pair distinction and validation-native matching relation terminal template

boundary_subset.definition: per seed/relation validation 25th percentile of absolute native matching-reader margin; test membership uses baseline pre-intervention margin only

metrics: global Mahalanobis distance in h12 covariance coordinates

same_immediate_different_survival: targeted and random conditions at identical strength; pair norm and first-order semantic projection exactly matched, semantic diagnostics reported
same_survival_orientation_control: validation chooses among 12 semantic-matched random residual directions the one with terminal survival closest to targeted condition; selection is frozen before test

wrong_stage.construction: same semantic-preserving projected-J rule recomputed at h4; compare functional effect to stage1

independent_probe: fixed R6-style ridge one-hot decoders trained on unperturbed train h12 and frozen
rotated_reader: fixed orthogonal latent rotation per seed applied before frozen W_out, generated from deterministic R11 namespace
adaptive_reader_secondary: run only if native rescue fails Level2 while rescued distinction remains semantically valid; fixed ridge + MLP64 battery, trained on systematically modified training trajectories using the same frozen intervention rule
dose_response: report all valid ladder strengths; primary inferential contrast uses validation-selected maximum semantic-valid strength
decision_logic: Use exactly Outcome A-J from user directive. Bidirectional success requires rescue positive and suppression negative for primary functional statistic in all three seeds with bootstrap CIs excluding zero.
claim_boundary: Geometric survival is not equated with reader-usable survival. No direct optimization of correct-answer logits. Native W_out remains frozen. Negative R10 reader-margin result is preserved.
